prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.1 °C (68% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.3 °C (50% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 56.7 °C (58% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.82 s (within 1% of healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 1309 W·min/l (242% above healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 2.08 l/min (68% below healthy); SE system efficiency factor 19.3 % (67% below healthy). Minor drop in delivered flow relative to motor power indicates early internal pump leakage.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 59.2 bar (27% above healthy). Elevated pressure ripple across working lines indicates moderate degradation of accumulator pre-charge.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 52.5 °C (69% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 58.9 °C (51% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 57.2 °C (59% above healthy). Elevated hydraulic oil temperature and reduced heat dissipation across the exchanger indicate severe cooler malfunction.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.68 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.57 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 3.30 l/min (49% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 784 W·min/l (104% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 31.1 % (47% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: close to total failure. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 57.3 bar (22% above healthy). Marked pressure ripple and reduced peak pressure indicate severe loss of hydraulic accumulator gas pre-charge.
